sloka: तच्च युद्धं मया दृष्टं यथावत्पुरुषर्षभ ।सभायां वासवस्याथ उपविष्टेन राघव ।। ७.७१.११ ॥
transliteration: tacca yuddhaṁ mayā dṛṣṭaṁ yathāvatpuruṣarṣabha ।sabhāyāṁ vāsavasyātha upaviṣṭena rāghava ।। 7.71.11 ॥

translations.english: O best among men, O Raghava, that battle was seen by me exactly as it happened, while I was seated in the assembly of Indra.
